tests.title: Query: "The Godfather"
tests.code: const res=await import_api.default.get_reccomendation_movies(item.q);const res_path=await import_api.default.generate_response_by_title(item.q,res);const titles=import_extractor.default.extractTitlesFromJson(res_path);const k=item.k??10;if(item.expect_empty){console.log("// Empty-state expectation");import_strict.default.equal(titles.length,0,`Expected empty result, but got ${titles.length} items.`);return}if(item.must_include?.length){const mrr=(0,import_metrics.mrrAtK)(titles,item.must_include,k);const min=item.min_mrr??.6;console.log("// must_include \u2192 MRR");import_strict.default.ok(mrr>=min,`Expected MRR to be at least ${min}, but got ${mrr}.`)}if(item.should_include_any?.length){const hits=titles.slice(0,k).map(t=>item.should_include_any.some(r=>t.toLowerCase().includes(String(r).toLowerCase())));const prec=(0,import_metrics.precisionAtK)(hits,Math.min(k,titles.length));const rec=(0,import_metrics.recallAtK)(titles,item.should_include_any);const ndcg=(0,import_metrics.ndcgAtK)(titles,item.should_include_any,k);const minP=item.min_precision??.3;const minR=item.min_recall??0;const minN=item.min_ndcg??.5;console.log("// should_include_any \u2192 Precision / Recall / NDCG");import_strict.default.ok(prec>=minP,`Expected Precision to be at least ${minP}, but got ${prec}.`);import_strict.default.ok(rec>=minR,`Expected Recall to be at least ${minR}, but got ${rec}.`);import_strict.default.ok(ndcg>=minN,`Expected NDCG to be at least ${minN}, but got ${ndcg}.`)}
